limitations: Date-only recommendations cannot verify intraday 15:00 mapping.
Historical attributes are retrospective downloads; source revision availability is documented separately. Original historical-vintage verification is reported in attribute_verification.
Stock universe is restricted to the existing cached price data.
Cross-industry and cross-board controls are permitted; historical-attribute completeness is reported separately in matching_diagnostics.csv.

attribute_verification.verification_scope: Record hashes, schema, coverage, unique keys, interval construction and declared availability filtering. Not authentication of original announcement dates or archived vintage equivalence.

market_cap.availability_rule: Use prior trading day's closing value; available_at conservatively next calendar midnight.

industry.data_status: normalized_public_historical_copy; final experiment readiness is assessed separately
industry.industry_level: SW level 2: first four original code digits followed by 00
industry.effective_interval: effective_from <= query_date < effective_to; missing effective_to means open-ended
industry.availability_rule: available_at = max(effective_from, update_time) + one calendar day; require available_at <= query_date
industry.query_date_semantics: Date-only event query, evaluated at the beginning of the local trading date. Integer milliseconds in the export encode dates, not verified publication instants.
industry.unknown_interval_rule: Exclude when the applicable interval is unavailable; never carry a superseded industry through a later effective interval.
industry.rows_after_study_end: Preserved before deriving effective_to; the consumer must apply effective and availability filters.
limitations: This is a non-official publication copy from a pinned public repository. Its author describes conversion from the SWS XLS; bytewise equivalence to that XLS has not been verified.
update_time is a source update field, not a verified original announcement time.
Historical revisions cannot be reconstructed from the single exported version.
Requiring both source dates to precede the query removes late-updated records and reduces available sample and candidate coverage.
Historical classification versions are retained. The original six-digit code remains available for version checks; no missing industry is inferred from today's classification.

prior_coverage_check.description: Source metadata's diagnostic on the original 7040-row event mapping; not the final experiment sample after deduplication, matching or label filtering.

attribute_verification.availability_policy: Prior-trading-day total cap becomes available at next calendar midnight. Industry applies only within its effective interval and after both its effective date and source update date, plus one day. Unavailable records are excluded; no snapshot fallback.
limitations: Industry history is a pinned public conversion of the claimed SWS official file; the official original was unavailable for comparison.
The industry's last-update field is not a verified first-publication timestamp; late updated intervals are conservatively excluded.
Both sources are retrospective data versions; past revisions cannot be reconstructed.
Back-mapped securities codes, missing historical listings and date-only recommendations can reduce the eligible sample.

reference_configuration.objective: User-adopted single-reference construction; fixed reference identities and distance fit retained

metric_aggregation: Compute per-seed MAE/RMSE on original units, then arithmetic seed mean and sample SD (ddof=1). A single-seed SD is unavailable.
prediction_checks: Every accepted main model/seed has exactly the prepared test event/tau/channel keys and matching inverse-transformed truth; dataset and normalization hashes also match.

best_direct.selection_rule: Lowest mean validation standardized MAE across main runs; ties resolved by model name

figures.step_errors: available; mean and sample SD over observed seeds
figures.cases: available; fixed stratified sample, validation-selected direct comparator
figures.retrieval: available; historical paths inverse-transformed from prepared y; query truth used only for plotting

timing_scope: Observed per-run timings; concurrent GPU training and variable memory sizes do not constitute serial same-device efficiency comparison.
